problems: e25: axle-hole ↔ pin is not a compatible pair
notes: Piece ids b1-b16 cover steps 1-4 of page 1; next page continues from b17.
The minifigure (helmet 4298609, visor 4163306, head 4186591, torso 4275401, legs 9339) is shown on this page but not in the catalogue or parts list, so it is not recorded.
Edges are given as the rests_on / other_joins of the page. Ports are null where I could not tell which studs are used from the small drawings.
Step 2: black plate 2x6 (b4) is on the underside of the wedge (b1). Its edge is listed as a joined edge between b1 and b4.
Step 2: placement of the two 1x2 plates is a best guess. One sits on the black 1x2 brick and the wedge, the other on the wedge.
Step 3: the two sloped skids (b10, b11) are assumed to clutch the black 2x6 plate.

Step 4: the Technic brick (b12) is assumed to sit on the 1x4 plate (b9). The hinge base (b13) sits on b12, and the white hinge top plate (b14) is hinged to it. The two trans-dark-blue round plates sit on the skids.
Page 2 covers steps 5 and 6. The rest of the page is advertising for other sets and adds nothing.

Step 5: the windscreen (b17) is assumed to sit on the 2x2 plate (b5) and the 1x4 plate (b9). The tile with top pin (b18) is assumed to sit on the hinge top plate (b14) and the windscreen. Exact stud positions are a guess from the small drawing.
Step 5 sub-assembly: the axle (b19) goes through the Technic brick's axle hole (b12). The angled connector (b20) is on its tail end, and the pin (b21) is in the connector's pin hole.
Step 6: the big propeller (b22) is assumed to fit on the tile's top pin (b18). The small propeller (b23) goes on the pin (b21) at the tail.

Step 6: the exact attachment points of the two clip pieces (b24 blaster, b25 camera) are unclear. I assumed they clip onto the skids (b10, b11). The trans-yellow round plate (b26) sits on the camera's stud.
The minifigure is built on page 1 and placed in the cockpit. It is not in the catalogue or parts list, so it is not recorded.
